description: Single persistent Copilot SDK session that processes all messages serially via a queue. Maintains conversation context across channels (Telegram, TUI, API). Session ID persisted to SQLite for recovery. Health-checked every 30s. Located in src/copilot/orchestrator.ts.
name: Orchestrator

description: Short-lived Copilot CLI sessions dispatched on-demand for coding tasks. Max 5 concurrent, fire-and-forget with async result callback via feedBackgroundResult(). Each worker auto-destroys after completion (~400MB freed). Sensitive dirs (.ssh, .aws, etc.) blocked. Located in src/copilot/tools.ts.
name: Worker System

description: Auto-selects model tier (fast/standard/premium) using GPT-4.1 as classifier. Design keywords always override to opus. 2-message cooldown prevents tier flapping. Manual model switch disables auto-routing. Config persisted to SQLite. Located in src/copilot/router.ts + classifier.ts.
name: Router

description: Express 5 HTTP API on localhost:7777. Bearer token auth from ~/.attache/api-token (mode 0o600). SSE streaming with 20s heartbeat. Endpoints: /stream (SSE), /message, /status, /workers, /model, /auto, /memory, /skills, /diagnostics, /restart, /send-photo. Located in src/api/server.ts.
name: API Server

description: React/Ink 4-pane terminal UI: workers list (left), transcript (center), inspector (right), composer (bottom). Polls daemon every 2s for sessions/diagnostics, streams responses via SSE. 120-entry transcript buffer. Responsive layout at 140-col breakpoint. Located in src/ui/ink/app.tsx.
name: Ink TUI

description: Readline-based fallback TUI designed for cmd.exe compatibility. Streaming ANSI markdown renderer, 1000-line persistent history in ~/.attache/tui_history. Slash commands for model/memory/skills/workers. Located in src/tui/index.ts.
name: Legacy TUI

description: grammy framework bot. Single authorized user via AUTHORIZED_USER_ID. Typing indicator every 4s. Messages chunked at 4096 chars with MarkdownV2→plaintext fallback. Proactive notifications for background worker completion. Located in src/telegram/bot.ts.
name: Telegram Bot

description: better-sqlite3 with WAL mode at ~/.attache/attache.db. Tables: worker_sessions (name unique, status, last_output), attache_state (key-value), conversation_log (max 200, pruned every 50 inserts, roles: user/assistant/system), memories (categories: preference/fact/project/person/routine). Located in src/store/db.ts.
name: Database

description: C# .NET 10 WinForms system-tray app. Manages daemon lifecycle (start/stop/restart), opens TUI via Windows Terminal or cmd.exe fallback, provides QuickInput dialog with SSE streaming. Three-strategy daemon launch (PATH→npm global→dev source). Auto-start via registry. Located in shell/.
name: AttacheShell

description: Three-directory hierarchy: bundled (skills/), local (~/.attache/skills), global (~/.agents/skills). SKILL.md + _meta.json format with YAML frontmatter. Later dirs override earlier by slug. Lazy-loaded on demand. Local-only removal. Kebab-case slug enforcement. Located in src/copilot/skills.ts.
name: Skills System
